description: This file defines a DeviceIdentity struct, along with utility functions and storage mechanisms for managing device identity information, including keys and device IDs. It also includes logic for generating cryptographic keys, signing payloads, and handling file path resolution for device identity storage.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A data structure representing device identity information, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityPaths
classes.description: A utility for resolving the directory path where device identity files are stored, based on environment variables or default directories.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: A class providing methods for loading, creating, saving, and signing device identities, including key generation and encoding functions.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL for storing device identity data, checking environment variables and default locations.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity from disk, or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string with the device's private key, returning a base64url-encoded signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity, including cryptographic key pair and device ID.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a URL-safe base64 string without padding.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key encoded as a base64 URL-safe string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves the device identity to disk.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL where device identity data is stored.
